Okay, can we talk about how weird weather is? Like, one minute it's sunny and you're thinking about wearing shorts, and the next minute the sky just dumps on you. No warning, no nothing. You're standing there like an idiot with no umbrella wondering what you did to deserve this.

And don't even get me started on weather forecasts. They'll tell you there's a "30 percent chance of rain" like that's supposed to mean something. Does that mean 30 percent of the area gets rain? Or there's a 30 percent chance I specifically will get rained on? Nobody knows! The weather guy just shrugs and moves on to the five-day outlook.

The worst part is when it's that gray, can't-make-up-its-mind kind of day. Not raining, not sunny, just... bleh. You can't plan anything because it could go either way. So you end up sitting at home scrolling through your phone, watching other people post pictures from places where the sun actually showed up. Super fun.

Honestly though? There's something kind of nice about a really good thunderstorm. When it's properly going for it, lightning and everything, and you're inside with a cup of tea? That's actually pretty great.
